nodes.label: Journey 04 — Review a diff and merge
nodes.rationale: 'Review before anything lands' is the safety promise, and this is the journey whose silent failure is genuinely dangerous — a merge that reports success while the base branch is untouched, or one that lands rejected work. Assert against git itself, not the UI's success message, since a broken merge reports success too; cover the discard and conflicting-merge cases separately.
